films.default_editorial: Alejandro González Iñárritu charged out of the gates with this combustible debut feature, planting the flag for a new golden age of Mexican cinema. films.default_editorial: An incomparable ensemble—ranging from Matthew McConaughey to Parker Posey—drives agreeably loose plotting through a day in the life of the American teenager in Linklater’s cult classic. films.default_editorial: Turquoise stones shimmer alongside the dream of unlikely community in Julian Radlmaier’s capacious and beguiling film. As interlocking stories illumine both the surreal frustrations and pleasurable delusions of romantic longing, this time-hopping fable stays satisfyingly bittersweet to the core.
